resources.string: Lets tutti read and change the TV’s settings, see what’s playing and wake the TV from off.
The TV shows a 4-digit code and you type it here. No key to make up in the TV’s menus.

The TV needs IP control turned on, with authentication set to “Normal” or “Normal and Pre-Shared Key”. On the TV: Settings › Network & Internet › Home network › IP control › Authentication (the path in Sony’s guide; your TV’s menu may word it slightly differently).
Set up with the code shown on the TV.
The TV no longer accepts tutti’s code: show a new one.
Show a code on the TV
Asking the TV for a code…
Enter the code shown on the TV
Four digits, as on the TV screen.
That code doesn’t match. Check the TV screen and try again.
Done: IP control is on. tutti will keep its access renewed on its own.
The TV didn’t answer. Check it’s on and on the same network as the phone.
The TV answered but won’t give a code. Check that IP control is on, with authentication “Normal” or “Normal and Pre-Shared Key”.
The TV’s screen is off, so it can’t show a code. Turn the TV on and try again.
The TV isn’t the one tutti knows (its certificate changed). Forget the TV and add it again.
That didn’t work. Try again, or use a PSK instead.
Picture and sound output: turn on IP control with a code shown on the TV.
